$comment: You do NOT need to commit a copy of this file. In a real deployment every
value below is set as a GitHub Actions *variable* on the repository, so a
customer configures their deployment without editing any tracked file.
Two ways to set it, and you can mix them:
A. One variable named DEVEX_CONFIG holding this whole object as JSON.
B. Discrete DEVEX_* variables (see the mapping against each field).
Discrete variables win over DEVEX_CONFIG, which wins over devex.config.json.
Copy this file to devex.config.json for local development — it is gitignored.

trial.title: Trunk-based development
trial.hypothesis: Smaller pull requests shorten review latency
